svg.title: Galaxy hyperlane audit: observed connections and temporary routes
svg.desc: All 15 destinations at equal-scale sector coordinates. Blue arrows show observed permanently open directions under the user's exhaustive temporary-route list. Solid red identifies temporary connections that can randomly open or close; current status is not encoded. Regional controls expand to their configured members. Unobserved non-temporary connections are omitted.

g.text: 15 destinations | Equal X/Y scale | Era 2026-09 / revision 2
Blue arrowheads show observed directions. Red lines show temporary controls, independent of current status.

g.text: A regional temporary control is drawn to each of its configured members.
Multiple regional red lines share one monitor status; they are not independent controls.
No range cutoff added. Out of Range does not establish connectivity. Hover a line for endpoints and evidence.
